currency.basis: Commons copy sourced from wb-bank.ru was uploaded in May 2026; RuStore APK icon dated 2026-07-28 uses the same design; both postdate the accepted baseline's gradient-circle variant and show the brand currently in use.

identity.basis: The candidate is the standalone 'Вайлдберриз Банк' logo: Wikimedia Commons file attributed to https://wb-bank.ru/ and described as the bank's logo, corroborated by the RuStore WB Bank app icon using the same magenta 'wb' pill mark. Same bank record (ООО ВБ Банк, RU).

assessment.independenceRationale: Two independent observation channels agree: (1) the wb-bank.ru-attributed logo raster and its vector copy archived on Wikimedia Commons, and (2) the WB Bank app icon distributed through RuStore's own CDN. Colors (#FF00C7 magenta, white mark) and lowercase-'wb' lettering match across both; neither derives from the accepted repository SVG.
uncertainties: Direct inspection of wb-bank.ru was blocked by an antibot JavaScript challenge, so the live site's exact usage was not observed first-hand; reliance is on the Commons copy explicitly sourced to wb-bank.ru plus the RuStore app icon.
Whether the purple-gradient-circle 'WB' baseline was ever an official bank variant is unresolved; it is recorded here as superseded by the evidenced current design, not as an identity dispute.

variant.basis: Candidate is the standalone mark variant: solid #FF00C7 pill with white lowercase 'wb' letters forming the mark, no accompanying bank name/slogan. Matches the isolated left part of the 2026 wb-bank.ru logo raster and the pill element inside the app icon; square-cell appropriate.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Pill fill #FF00C7 and white 'wb' counters preserved exactly; no invented colors; dark-theme render identical to light.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Pill is a wide rounded rectangle (about 424x250); centered in the square cell with balanced margins, appropriate as an application icon on both backgrounds.
candidate.rationale: Accepted icon is the retired purple-magenta gradient circle with uppercase 'WB'; the bank's current standalone mark is the solid #FF00C7 pill with white lowercase 'wb', confirmed by the 2026 wb-bank.ru logo (Commons copy) and the 2026-07-28 RuStore app icon. Supported rebrand replacement for the same bank.
candidate.role: standalone app-style mark: rounded pill containing the lowercase 'wb' lettering, no wordmark
transforms: SVGO (installed /usr/local/bin/svgo), frozen repository svgo.config.mjs, multipass; 3302 -> 2017 bytes trial; selected after viewBox isolation (sha256 recorded in final evidence).

From the official 1000x250.09 lockup SVG, the standalone pill group (pill path + white 'wb' path) was isolated and the viewBox tightened to 0 0 424.36 250.09; the separate black «банк» wordmark path was excluded; no path geometry, colors, or fills were edited. The pill-only variant is source-supported by the RuStore app icon and the standalone-mark Commons raster.
candidate.variant: mark-only variant isolated from the official lockup; transparent background, square-cell appropriate
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Evidenced rebrand: gradient purple 'WB' circle replaced by the current solid magenta 'wb' pill; visibly different design confirmed by two independent current sources.

proposals.reason: Accepted baseline (purple-to-magenta gradient circle with white uppercase 'WB') does not match the bank's current standalone mark: the solid magenta (#FF00C7) pill with white lowercase 'wb', confirmed by the wb-bank.ru-sourced logo uploaded to Wikimedia Commons in 2026 and by the WB Bank app icon published on RuStore (2026-07-28 upload). Fetched the standalone vector mark as a candidate; identity, currency, and suitability are supported by independent sources.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Vector version of the wb-bank.ru 2026 logo per the Commons raster's own page; standalone magenta pill with white lowercase 'wb' (#FF00C7 fill), 1000x250.09 viewBox, no accompanying text; supported as the bank's current standalone mark by the 2026 Commons upload from wb-bank.ru and the 2026-07-28 RuStore app icon.

sources.independenceGroup: wb-bank.ru logo as archived on Wikimedia Commons
sources.observation: Commons file 'WB Bank logo 2026.webp' (300x75, described as Russian 'Логотип «Вайлдберриз Банк»', source https://wb-bank.ru/, uploaded 9 May 2026). Raster shows a solid magenta pill with white lowercase 'wb'. Its page points to vector version File:WB_Bank_Logo.svg.

sources.independenceGroup: wb-bank.ru logo (Commons archival copy of official asset)
sources.observation: Direct GET of wb-bank.ru returns a JavaScript antibot challenge page (1132 bytes, /__wbaas/challenges/antibot/...), so the homepage itself could not be inspected without a browser. The vector asset is the Commons-uploaded copy attributed to wb-bank.ru (source field on the Commons file page); SVG is 1000x250.09 viewBox, two fills: #FF00C7 (pill) and #FFFFFF (lowercase 'wb'), standalone mark with no accompanying text.

RuStore listing for 'ru.wildberries.bank' (WB Bank app, APK uploaded 2026-07-28): app icon is a solid magenta square with white 'wb' pill and 'банк' lettering below — confirms current brand colors and the lowercase-'wb' pill mark, but the app icon itself carries separate lettering so it is not suitable as a standalone cell mark.
